clips.title: The story
paras: Thorgas Grimson is the resident dwarf hunter trainer stationed inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A seasoned outdoorsman of Dun Morogh, he firmly believes that hands-on survival in the freezing wilds is the finest teacher any fledgling marksman can have.

Perched inside the stone halls of Anvilmar, Thorgas Grimson welcomes novice mountaineers and scouts taking their very first steps into the harsh snowdrifts of Coldridge Valley. Rather than bogging young hunters down with dry lectures, Grimson espouses a practical philosophy: real skill is forged out in the freezing winds, bow or gun in hand, tracking Dun Morogh's rugged beasts firsthand.
